mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and renal impairment that may potentiate baclofen's CNS depression and increase seizure risk, while both drugs can cause neurotoxicity.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially calcium and magnesium), and CNS effects closely; adjust baclofen dose if renal function declines; consider alternative antivirals if possible.
